summary: Frontend-only regression after luxury UI revamp (Hero cinematic bottle stage, Collection cards, Product page cinematic panel, obsidian Footer with newsletter). All critical flows verified: hero image switcher, scroll-to-collection, quick-add from collection cards, cart drawer inc/dec/remove with subtotal updates (₹18,500 → ₹37,000 → ₹18,500 → ₹51,500 after mixed adds), proceed-to-checkout navigation to /checkout, product detail page (qty-inc/qty-dec/add-to-bag-btn), theme toggle (light→dark), and footer newsletter success.

issues: Framer-motion warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position' - caused by useScroll target on hero section's ref container; non-blocking but should set position: relative on the scrolled container to silence.
A11y warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to CartDrawer sheet content.

action_items: (Low) Silence framer-motion useScroll warning by giving the Hero section's scroll target an explicit non-static position (section already has 'relative' but useScroll offset target may need the viewport container; verify).
(Low) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to CartDrawer Sheet to resolve Radix a11y warning.

(Info) Observed 3x 401 responses on initial home load - these appear to be from an authenticated /api/me style probe when no user is logged in; silence by not calling auth-required endpoints for guests, or treat 401 as expected and skip console.error.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero FALLBACK list uses hard-coded INR prices; fine as fallback but ensure product.image path matches new /images/<slug>.jpg assets (verified blonde-amber/layton/side-effect loaded 200).
Collection uses product.stock to disable quick-add (sold variant) - no stock=0 product tested; works logically.
Footer newsletter is pure client-side (no API call) - acceptable per request, but no persistence; main agent may want to wire to backend later.
Old BottleScene.js remains in /components/site but unused - safe to delete to avoid dead code.
test_credentials: Not needed (guest flow). Admin creds documented in request but not exercised.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI revamp verified end-to-end on desktop 1920x1080. All data-testid selectors present and working: hero-bottle-stage, hero-swatch-<slug>, hero-active-price, hero-discover-active, hero-shop-btn, product-card-<slug>, product-price-<slug>, quick-add-<slug>, cart-count, cart-drawer, cart-inc-/cart-dec-/cart-remove-, cart-subtotal, cart-checkout-btn, qty-inc, qty-dec, add-to-bag-btn, theme-toggle, newsletter-input, newsletter-submit, newsletter-success, site-footer. Cart drawer auto-opens after quick-add (so cart-open-btn click isn't necessary after add; it is however still present and visible in header). No console/page errors other than noted warnings and benign 401 probes.
